title: Blush Carré Bracelet
body: A tennis bracelet of square princess cut pale pink cubic zirconia of about 4mm, each stone in its own square gold four claw setting and linked edge to edge, so the line reads as one unbroken band of soft colour. It closes with a slim fold over clasp. Wear it to a haldi or a sangeet, or with a white kurta when you want colour that stays gentle.
tip: Pair it with a clear line bracelet so the pink sits between two rows of light.
stone: Square princess cut pale pink cubic zirconia, approximately 4mm each
macro: square pale pink stones in square gold claw settings
